name: Ari
description: a young woman with a white chin-length bob with straight bangs whose tips fade to aqua, a teal headband, pale skin, light blue eyes, blue teardrop earrings, a thin gold chain necklace with one round blue gem pendant resting at the front of her neck, a very curvy figure with a large bust, wide hips and thick thighs. She wears a cropped teal long-sleeved top with a black high collar and a black yoke across the shoulders, black cut-out shoulders, puffy teal sleeves with black ribbed cuffs; white high-waisted shorts with a scalloped hem and two vertical rows of three black buttons on the front; bare legs; white chunky platform sneakers with teal soles and teal lace panels. No other accessories, no tattoos, no bracelets, no socks.

shoes: white platform sneakers with teal soles and lace panels, both feet in frame on body views
body: bust, hips and thighs as in the source, pale skin; no tattoos, no bracelet, no anklet, no socks, no extra garment
